name: publication_device_states
description: The latest synchronization report of each screen as the screen stated it, with the time the server received it and the desired publication it answered. Reported publication IDs are untrusted.
lifecycle: Inserted at a screen's first synchronization and overwritten by each later report. Kept with the device record.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the screen; immutable (tenant key).
PostgreSQL-clock instant the last report was received; the panel's connection state derives from it (AT-24).
Protocol agreed for the last exchange.
Publication the server answered as desired.
columns.Null meaning: The screen's source had no publication.
The screen reported no active publication.

columns.Meaning: Activation time the screen reported, by its own clock.
columns.Null meaning: The screen reported no active publication.

columns.Meaning: Previous valid publication the screen reported keeping.

columns.Null meaning: The screen reported no staging attempt.

columns.Meaning: Reported failure code of a failed staging attempt.
Bytes the screen reported as downloaded for the attempt.
Bytes the attempt needs, as the screen reported.
Reported playback condition: PLAYING, NEUTRAL, AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED, CLOCK_UNTRUSTED, DEGRADED or SETUP.
The screen's clock reading when it reported.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The screen belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((staging_failure IS NULL) OR ((staging_failure)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['STORAGE_FULL'::character varying, 'DOWNLOAD_FAILED'::character varying, 'INTEGRITY_FAILED'::character varying, 'INVALID_MANIFEST'::character varying, 'INCOMPATIBLE'::character varying])::text[]))))
constraints.Purpose: Failure codes come from a closed set.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((playback)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PLAYING'::character varying, 'NEUTRAL'::character varying, 'AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED'::character varying, 'CLOCK_UNTRUSTED'::character varying, 'DEGRADED'::character varying, 'SETUP'::character varying])::text[])))
constraints.Purpose: Playback conditions come from a closed set.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((staging_publication_id IS NULL) AND (staging_state IS NULL) AND (staging_failure IS NULL) AND (staging_bytes_done IS NULL) AND (staging_bytes_total IS NULL)) OR ((staging_publication_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((staging_state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DOWNLOADING'::character varying, 'VERIFYING'::character varying, 'READY'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((staging_failure IS NULL) = ((staging_state)::text <> 'FAILED'::text)) AND (staging_bytes_done >= 0) AND (staging_bytes_total >= 0))))
constraints.Purpose: A staging attempt has a publication, a known state, a failure only when failed, and byte counts.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((storage_free_bytes IS NULL) = (storage_total_bytes IS NULL)) AND ((storage_free_bytes IS NULL) OR ((storage_free_bytes >= 0) AND (storage_free_bytes <= storage_total_bytes)))))
constraints.Purpose: Storage is reported as a pair with free space within the total.
